scaleBasis: The legible lower 7800 mm dimension spans source x=648 to x=1068, approximately 420 px. Use 780/420 = 1.857142857 cm/px uniformly in x and y. Source origin translated from (242,182) px. The raster is a decorated marketing plan and dimension tick picks are approximate.
assumptions: Source raster is 1536 x 1026 pixels. Every point and furniture footprint uses world=(source-(242,182))*780/420; x is rightward and y is downward.

All wall, furniture and opening positions were traced directly from the supplied source, without consulting a reference reconstruction. Thick black wall centrelines are approximately located; thin partitions are less certain.

Windows use floor-to-ceiling fixed glass following wall height as a semantic-white-model presentation default. The source does not establish glazing height, sill heights, wall height, door style, or furniture height.

All doors initially use ordinary default doors; wide balcony and kitchen apertures preserve source span but the source likely depicts sliding glazing. Exact leaf count, hinges and style are not asserted.

Guest-bath access on the lower part of its west partition is ambiguous under the decorated raster; d04 is an inferred opening with low confidence. No kitchen-to-utility balcony door is asserted because the left kitchen wall appears continuous; the utility balcony remains accessible from the dining opening.
The upper guest room has a shallow north bay at x542..656, y310..345 px. The pale strip above the adjoining guest bathroom is treated as an exterior ledge/void rather than a room or extra partition.

Apparent shallow south bay ledges below the centre bedroom and right suite are represented as independent window_sill or bench blocks beyond the main wall, rather than asserted full-height room extensions. Their detailed glazing returns remain uncertain.

Balcony railings are independent railing semantic blocks at estimated 110 cm height, not structural walls. No balcony floor polygons are supplied; the importer derives enclosed room topology and may not create exterior balcony slabs from these railings.

All clearly recognizable furniture/fixtures are approximate rectangular semantic occupancy blocks. Sofas are split into visible sections. Tableware, rugs, text, door swing arcs, plants except the larger balcony planter, and minute decor were omitted.
Furniture height is estimated. Shower blocks describe occupancy, not an asserted solid architectural enclosure. Countertop fixtures overlap their supporting counter blocks intentionally.
No visible curved structural wall was identified. Curved strokes are door swing arcs or furniture outlines and were not converted to walls.
limitation: Structural checks and registration consistency do not certify source-image accuracy.
